metadata.name: Vison realism layer: post-process, atmosphere, clouds, fog, Lumen, TSR
metadata.author: Vison (contrib)
metadata.engine: Unreal Engine 5.8 (property names checked against the UE 5.8 Python API docs; cvars follow UE 5.x)

target_hardware.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 SUPER, 8 GB GDDR6 (Turing, 1st-gen RT cores)

layering: 2. lighting_presets.json (physical sun/moon, EV100 exposure, grading, camera)
3. THIS FILE: same block names, so ContribLighting::Apply / apply_realism.py can write it the same way
4. presets.<id>._tier_overrides[Epic|Medium] for the active scalability level (High = base)

chapter_mapping._arena_note: Free-play 'arena' has no story look. Reuse 'city' or keep the project defaults.

consistency.rule: Keys shared with lighting_presets.json carry the same value unless listed in presets.<id>._differs_from_lighting_presets (Lumen cost tuning only). No sun/moon, exposure, white balance or grading keys appear here.
consistency.project_perf_budget: High-tier scalability values match the live IronManArena/Config/DefaultScalability.ini and DefaultEngine.ini [SystemSettings] written from contrib/ultron/perf_budget.md. Deliberate differences: r.Lumen.TraceMeshSDFs.Allow=1 at High (Ultron/engine 0) and per-preset Lumen post-process qualities (see postprocess_realism_notes.md, Conflicts).

frame_budget_ms_High_default._label: ESTIMATE for a typical outdoor preset at High, 1080p output, TSR ~70% internal; a fixed 75% adds ~1.0-1.3 ms. Not measured on hardware

conventions.colors: linear {R,G,B,A}; FColor properties (GroundAlbedo, VolumetricFogAlbedo) are written as sRGB (FLinearColor::ToFColor(true))
conventions.units: SkyAtmosphere/VolumetricCloud distances in km; fog distances in cm (UE units)
conventions.underscore_keys: documentation only; appliers skip keys that start with _
conventions.misspelling: AerialPespectiveViewDistanceScale is UE's own spelling (aerial_pespective_view_distance_scale in Python)

lumen.choice: software Lumen (global + mesh distance fields) for High and Medium; hardware Lumen optional at Epic only
reasoning: Turing's 1st-gen RT cores and 8 GB: HW Lumen at 1080p/60 adds ~4-6 ms (BVH/TLAS build for Nanite fallback meshes, plus ray traversal), which doesn't fit with VSM + clouds + volumetric fog in 16.6 ms.
Software Lumen at the High scalability level is Epic's 60 fps configuration.

The project already ships SW Lumen (r.Lumen.HardwareRayTracing=False) with on-demand RT (r.RayTracing.EnableOnDemand=1); the in-game 'Hardware ray tracing' toggle (UArenaGameUserSettings::ApplyRenderingSettings) is the Epic-tier HW path, at an expected ~30-35 fps.
Every light is movable (no lightmaps), so Lumen stays ON at Medium too, against the engine default, which turns it off at Medium.

rendering_decisions.default_tier: High (sg.*=2) at 1080p output, TSR, 75% fixed screen percentage when dynamic res is off (1440x810); dynamic res 67-100% (the live Ultron config) usually settles around 67-75% on this GPU

anti_aliasing.AntiAliasingMethod: TSR (r.AntiAliasingMethod=4, already set by the project)

dynamic_resolution.note: High's proposal equals the live config. The per-tier Epic/Medium ranges in DefaultScalability_realism.ini only take effect if the Min/Max lines are removed from [SystemSettings] (SystemSettings beats scalability). OperationMode 2 = always on (no code needed); supported on PC DX12 and Vulkan.

rendering_decisions.bloom: Standard (SOG, ~0.25 ms) for gameplay and for cutscenes at High/Medium; Convolution (FFT, ~1.5-2.5 ms at 1080p) only in Epic-tier cutscenes

scalability._note: Values mirrored in DefaultScalability_realism.ini (same generator). Sections merge over BaseScalability.ini; keys not listed keep engine values.

Epic._label: ESTIMATE, RTX 2070 SUPER, 1080p output, not measured

hardware_lumen_option.how: in-game 'Hardware ray tracing' toggle (sets r.RayTracing.Enable / r.Lumen.HardwareRayTracing / r.RayTracing.Shadows to 1)

Epic.note: Epic is a 40-48 fps quality mode on this GPU (Epic designs Lumen Epic for 30 fps on consoles). FFT cutscene bloom adds ~1.5-2.5 ms.

High._label: ESTIMATE, RTX 2070 SUPER, 1080p output, not measured
High.note: Recommended default. Lands around 60 fps at ~70% internal; dynamic res (67-100%, live config) absorbs heavy presets (titan_battlefield, rooftops_storm). High VSM/Lumen/TSR/streaming values equal the live Ultron DefaultScalability.ini / [SystemSettings].

Medium._label: ESTIMATE, RTX 2070 SUPER, 1080p output, not measured
Medium.note: Keeps screen-probe Lumen on (cheaper probes, half-res reflections) because nothing is baked. ~85-95 fps, or a safe 60 fps on weaker GPUs. Alternative: Ultron proposes 5.8 'Lumen Lite' (Irradiance Field Gather + SSR) for Medium (verify; not checked here).

verify.why: The 5.8 docs tooltip names it r.VolumetricCloud.ViewRaySampleCountMax. Check which spelling the 5.8 console accepts.
Cloud sky-AO toggle; existence in 5.8 not confirmed from docs.
Reduced-res cloud tracing toggle (5.0+); existence in 5.8 not confirmed from docs.
Name not confirmed from docs; the PP override LumenFrontLayerTranslucencyReflections is confirmed.
May be a read-only project setting rather than a runtime scalability cvar in 5.8.
Whether 5.8 ignores height-fog directional inscattering when a SkyAtmosphere sun is present (black is safe either way).
Property exists in 5.8; the value 1.0 is the assumed default.
Volumetric fog and VSM are in ShadowQuality and sky atmosphere in EffectsQuality, as in BaseScalability; volumetric clouds were also put in EffectsQuality (BaseScalability may not set them).

prologue._look: Ozone keeps the 04:50 windows blue, not grey. Volumetric fog in the lamp beams is the hero; clouds are almost invisible, so they run at half samples. FG 1.5 gives the garage soft bounce off the concrete without Epic cost.

_gpu_estimate_ms._label: ESTIMATE, RTX 2070 SUPER, 1080p output, TSR ~70% internal (where 67-100% dynamic res is expected to settle), not measured

SkyAtmosphere._note: Lake and forest ground. Twilight colour comes from the sun 4 deg under the horizon; ozone (OtherAbsorption) is what keeps the blue hour blue rather than grey.
SkyAtmosphere._units: km for radius/height/distributions/start depth; GroundAlbedo is linear (written to an FColor as sRGB, like lighting_presets).

VolumetricCloud._note: PlanetRadius matches SkyAtmosphere.BottomRadius (6360 km); UE uses the atmosphere's radius when one is present. ReflectionViewSampleCountScaleValue / ShadowReflectionViewSampleCountScaleValue are the 5.x names of the old Reflection(Shadow)SampleCountScale. Shadow* scales only matter with ray-marched shadows on the Volumetric Advanced output. _cloud_material names are suggestions for the cloud material's parameters, not engine properties.

ExponentialHeightFog._note: Density, falloff, colour and volumetric values are copied unchanged from lighting_presets.json. DirectionalInscattering is black because the SkyAtmosphere (HeightFogContribution) and the volumetric fog already put the sun's glow into the fog; a non-black value double-counts it (verify the 5.8 behaviour). Emissive is 0: fire glow is better as Local Fog Volumes (project has SupportLocalFogVolumes) plus real lights. There is no static lighting, so StaticLightingScatteringIntensity is inert. Volumetric grid resolution comes from scalability (ShadowQuality group).

_bloom_profile.name: tungsten_practical
_bloom_profile.why: warm halo round work lamps, moderate wide glow from dust

_exposure.note: No exposure, white-balance or grading keys are set here, so nothing conflicts with lighting_presets.

PostProcessVolume._note: Lumen qualities multiply the scalability baseline (sg.GlobalIlluminationQuality / ReflectionQuality); these are the High-tier (default) values for an RTX 2070 SUPER. MotionBlurTargetFPS 60 makes gameplay blur frame-rate independent (180 deg at 60 fps = 1/120 s); cutscenes keep 24 from lighting_presets' CineCamera. FilmGrainTexelSize (in lighting_presets) has no 5.8 property and is skipped by both appliers.

CineCamera._note: Merged over lighting_presets' CineCamera.PostProcessOverrides (camera, exposure and 24 fps shutter unchanged).

_tier_overrides._how: Apply the preset's blocks, then merge the block for the active sg level (Epic=3, Medium=1). High (2) is the base.

ViewSampleCountScale.why: clouds are only seen through windows here (lighting_presets' own note suggests 0.5)

LumenFinalGatherQuality.why: 2070 SUPER: 2.0 on top of the High baseline costs ~+1.5 ms; 1.5 keeps the interior bounce for ~+0.7 ms (Epic tier restores 2.0)

LumenSceneLightingQuality.why: 1.0 at High on the 2070 SUPER (Epic tier restores the lighting_presets value)

LumenSceneDetail.why: more surface-cache cards cost memory/updates on 8 GB; 1.0 at High (Epic restores)

LumenReflectionQuality.why: 1.0 at High; full-res reflections come from r.Lumen.Reflections.DownsampleFactor=1 instead (Epic restores)

LumenSceneLightingUpdateSpeed.why: fast-changing light (lightning / explosions) needs quicker surface-cache updates

LumenFinalGatherLightingUpdateSpeed.why: fast-changing light (lightning / explosions) needs quicker final-gather convergence

LumenFinalGatherQuality.why: cutscenes run in real time on the 2070 SUPER; FG 4 / scene 2 / detail 2 / reflection 2 is ~+4-6 ms. High uses 2/1/1/1 (Epic restores lighting_presets)

LumenSceneLightingQuality.why: cutscenes run in real time on the 2070 SUPER; FG 4 / scene 2 / detail 2 / reflection 2 is ~+4-6 ms. High uses 2/1/1/1 (Epic restores lighting_presets)

LumenSceneDetail.why: cutscenes run in real time on the 2070 SUPER; FG 4 / scene 2 / detail 2 / reflection 2 is ~+4-6 ms. High uses 2/1/1/1 (Epic restores lighting_presets)

LumenReflectionQuality.why: cutscenes run in real time on the 2070 SUPER; FG 4 / scene 2 / detail 2 / reflection 2 is ~+4-6 ms. High uses 2/1/1/1 (Epic restores lighting_presets)

finale._look: Sunrise through clearing smoke: lavender shadows from sky multiple scattering, pink-gold cloud undersides (raise MultiScatteringContribution in the material), and a warm veil bloom.

ExponentialHeightFog._note: Density, falloff, colour and volumetric values are copied unchanged from lighting_presets.json.
